title: Dispatch: olc5.11 repair review P1 dice-duration binding (attempt 5)
description:
Repair PR #663 (eshyra-olc5.11) for review P1 at de4c457f (user review, CHANGES REQUESTED). Branch eshyra-olc5.11.5 from eshyra-olc5.11 at de4c457f. Review P2 is NOT in scope: it is owned by pre-freeze bead eshyra-olc5.13 (do not touch item_state_event semantics here).

DEFECT (P1, class): packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts ~3660-3700 accepts any caller-chosen integer inside a dice range (e.g. 4 for typed '1d4 hours', Potion of Growth) as matching the typed item duration, and packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolStartEffect.ts ~322 reports itemDurationBinding 'bound' for ANY object-typed duration. A caller-selected number is labelled as the printed rolled result with no roll evidence. ADR 0020: dice are deterministic. eshyra-p3dq: unrolled dice durations must stay explicitly unbound.

DESIGN (user-approved 2026-10-14):
1. Engine rolls the printed dice. For an item-sourced start_effect whose item effect has a typed DICE duration, the caller OMITS the amount (make the duration argument optional exactly for item-sourced effects with a typed duration; keep it required everywhere else). The tool rolls the typed expression with the campaign's seeded ctx.rng (same deterministic RNG path item state timers use: packages/core/src/state/itemTimers.ts resolveItemStateTimers), uses the typed unit, persists the rolled amount, and reports itemDurationBinding {status:'bound'} plus the roll evidence (expression, individual dice, total). Replay must be deterministic.
2. Fixed typed durations: omitted -> engine fills the typed fixed amount/unit, bound. Supplied and exactly equal -> bound (current behavior kept).
3. DM override (house rules / adjudication stay with the DM; house rules are prose by design, campaignRules.ts). A caller may supply an explicit duration that differs from the printed one, or any explicit amount for a dice-typed duration, ONLY with an explicit override declaration (e.g. durationOverride: {basis: 'dm-adjudicated' | 'house-rule', reason: string, ruleId?: string}). If ruleId is given it must resolve to an ACTIVE campaign rule of kind 'house-rule' (use the campaign rule read interface; refuse otherwise). Result: itemDurationBinding {status:'unbound', reason naming the basis/ruleId}. Never 'bound'.
4. Fail closed: an explicit amount for a dice-typed (or mismatched fixed) duration WITHOUT an override declaration is refused (invalid_args) with a message telling the DM to omit the amount (engine rolls) or declare an override. Remove the range-check acceptance in activeEffects.ts; the state boundary must not accept an unrolled in-range number as the typed duration.
5. Persisted effect semantics: the stored active effect must record duration provenance (engine-rolled with evidence / typed fixed / DM override with basis+reason+ruleId) so a later reader cannot mistake an override for the printed duration. If the active-effect store has no field for this, add the minimal one following the existing migration conventions.
6. Untyped durations: unchanged (unbound, DM adjudicates).
Update the start_effect tool description so the model knows to omit the amount for printed item durations and how to declare an override.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE: parameterized tests over dice-typed item durations (incl. Potion of Growth / Diminution from the GENERATED pack) covering: omitted -> rolled, bound, evidence matches seeded rng, persisted provenance; in-range amount without override -> refused, nothing persisted; amount with dm-adjudicated override -> unbound + provenance; house-rule override with active ruleId -> unbound; with unknown/inactive ruleId -> refused. Fixed typed: omitted -> bound; exact -> bound; mismatch without override -> refused; with override -> unbound. Replay determinism for the rolled case.

ALSO: these changes satisfy eshyra-p3dq's acceptance criteria (dice durations bind only when deterministically resolved and linked; no averages/fixed defaults; unrolled stays unbound; tests both ways). Confirm item by item in your completion notes; do NOT close p3dq (the captain closes it when #663 merges).

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: design as implemented, schema/migration changes if any, test list, p3dq AC mapping.
notes:
USER AUTHORIZED 2026-10-14: the user approved this P1 design; P2 is owned by eshyra-olc5.13 (pre-freeze). Implement per plan.
Dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high from de4c457f; PGID 66975.
COMPLETION REPORT (2026-10-15): Implemented the approved dice-duration binding repair. Item-sourced effects now resolve typed fixed durations when omitted (or bind exact supplied values), and roll typed dice expressions with the campaign seeded RNG when duration is omitted. Bound dice results return expression/die/total evidence; state validation replays that evidence against the pack expression and rejects caller-selected or unprovenanced values. Explicit duration changes require durationOverride with basis and reason, persist as unbound provenance, and an optional ruleId must resolve to an active house-rule campaign rule. Untyped item effects remain unbound and DM-adjudicated. Updated start_effect guidance and capability inventory. Added migration 0046_active_effect_duration_provenance.sql plus schema snapshot update to persist duration provenance; no other schema changes. Evidence: activeEffects.test.ts covers generated Potion of Growth and Potion of Diminution, seeded RNG evidence and replay, refusal/no persistence for caller-selected in-range dice, state-boundary evidence enforcement, DM and house-rule overrides, unknown/revoked rule IDs, and fixed typed omission/exact/mismatch. migrationLegacyAdoption.test.ts and persistence.test.ts cover migration 46. p3dq AC mapping: (1) dice bind only after engine roll and pack effectRef linkage; (2) no averages/defaults, actual seeded dice are rolled; (3) an unrolled caller value is refused, while an explicit override stays unbound; (4) both rolled/bound and refused/unbound paths have permanent tests. Verification: npm run verify:worktree passed (363 files passed, 2 skipped; 6790 tests passed, 3 skipped). Commit: c5f32a3e50406132df78046a136e998ab10ccda1. P2 / item_state_event semantics were not touched; p3dq and parent bead eshyra-olc5.11 remain open.
